before.title: How many producers does a virtual event need? | West Peek Productions
before.description: A simple webinar may need one producer plus a host, but high-stakes summits, multi-speaker events, hybrid programs, sponsor-supported events, or executive productions often need separate roles for show calling, speaker management, moderation, and technical support.
